# url-state-codec

> A tiny codec for serializing JSON state into shareable URL-safe strings (base64url).

`@jswork/url-state-codec` encodes a JSON state object into a URL-safe, padding-free base64url string (suitable for query params like `?state=...`), and decodes it back. Non-ASCII values (Chinese, emoji) are supported. `decode` returns `null` for absent/empty/corrupted input so call sites can fall back to defaults silently.
